description: Main React component for the Tic Tac Toe front-end application, handling game state, user interactions, UI components, and audit logging.

methods.name: startNewGame
methods.description: Initializes a new game state, logs the action, and shows a success toast; handles errors by logging and showing error toasts.

methods.name: onModeChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the game mode, logs the change, and provides user feedback via toast; handles errors gracefully.

methods.name: handleMove
methods.description: Processes user move actions, updates game state, invokes AI moves if applicable, and logs each step; also manages errors.
